body: Eight years ago today, the world lost Mac Miller at just 26 years old 🕊️ His honesty, creativity and one-of-a-kind sound left an impact that can still be felt throughout music today. From the songs that helped fans through difficult moments to the memories attached to every album, Mac’s legacy continues to live on through millions of listeners around the world. Rest in peace, Mac Miller. Forever missed and never forgotten ❤️🙏
